settings.title: Pi settings
settings.piPath.name: Pi binary path
settings.piPath.desc: Full path to the Pi executable. Uses PATH by default.
settings.nodePath.name: Node bin directory (optional)
settings.nodePath.desc: Directory containing the Node binary. Leave empty for auto-detection. Needed when GUI apps can't find Node (nvm/fnm users).
settings.rpcTimeout.name: RPC timeout (seconds)
settings.rpcTimeout.desc: Timeout for RPC requests to Pi. Increase it for slow operations, such as model switching.
settings.workingDir.name: Working directory
settings.workingDir.desc: Working directory for Pi (empty = parent folder of vault). Note: not supported on mobile.
settings.sessionDir.name: Session save directory
settings.persistSessions.name: Persist sessions
settings.persistSessions.desc: Automatically save conversations as vault notes
settings.thinkingLevel.name: Thinking level
settings.thinkingLevel.desc: Level of thinking and reasoning for the model
settings.defaultProvider.name: Default provider
settings.defaultProvider.desc: Default LLM provider (for example, anthropic or openai)
settings.defaultProvider.placeholder: Leave empty to use Pi default
settings.defaultModel.name: Default model
settings.defaultModel.placeholder: Leave empty to use Pi default
settings.apiKeys.title: API keys
settings.apiKeys.heading: API keys
settings.apiKeys.noConfig: Could not load Pi configuration from ~/.pi/agent/models.json. Run Pi first to create it.
settings.apiKeys.info: API keys are stored securely in your system keychain via Obsidian SecretStorage. Enter keys below—they will be passed to Pi as environment variables.
settings.apiKeys.enterNew: Key stored — enter a new key to update it
settings.apiKeys.refreshDesc: Reload the provider list from Pi configuration
settings.apiKeys.desc: API key for {{envVar}}. Stored in plugin settings.
settings.apiKeys.custom.name: Custom provider
settings.apiKeys.custom.desc: For other providers, set the key through data.json or environment variables.
